question: How many days of paid time off do full-time employees get each year?
answer: Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid time off (PTO) per calendar year, which accrues monthly at a rate of 1.67 days per month, starting on the first day of employment, [1].

question: How much unused PTO can I carry over into next year?
